iWant: Squire to tell me before a big job (deep research, building an app or a site, video work) and wait for my yes
soThat: a big job never uses up my allowance without my say
description: The heavy-job journey: classify the job, read usage, warn, yes or no, run. It serves deep research, build me an app, video and audio work and site builds. Default: above 90% usage in either window a heavy job needs a second yes.
title: Heavy jobs: warned first, started on a yes

acceptanceCriteria.description: Before a big job, Squire warns the Squire owner and waits for their yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A heavy job: deep research, building an app, building a site, or video and audio work
acceptanceCriteria.when: The job is about to start
acceptanceCriteria.then: Squire warns the Squire owner first and the job starts only on a yes; above 90% usage in either window it needs a second yes; no path starts it without the yes.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A heavy job the Squire owner approved ends with a visible result, or keeps its work when it fails; shipping an app still needs its own yes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Approved deep research, and an approved one-page brief for an app
acceptanceCriteria.when: The job runs, and the network fails, the job times out or a step of the build fails
acceptanceCriteria.then: Approved research ends with a result the Squire owner can see; a network or time-out failure is explained and the work so far is kept so it can resume. An approved app brief runs through plan, build, test and preview; a failure keeps the work; shipping the app still needs its own yes.
